name: delta-every-table-oracle-canonicalises-properties
body: The every-table oracle canonicalises the rel properties column (decode then re-encode) because the splice's batched code-rel MERGE leaves the empty column on Contains, Calls, UnresolvedCall and UnresolvedUse rows where a full load writes {}, and both decode to the empty map per layers::properties_from_json; Uses rows already match byte for byte, since apply's step-6 re-merge sets every Uses edge's properties exactly as the full load's rel_props renders them ({} when absent). Every other column of every row is compared raw. Upgrade by setting r.properties to the empty map on the remaining code-rel re-merges in apply's step 6 and dropping the normalisation if raw-column identity is required.
